title: Anacardium Occidentale
text: This remedy is characterized by its action on the skin and the digestive system. It is useful in cases of skin diseases and chronic diarrhoea. There is a general feeling of weakness and debility. It is also useful in cases of enlarged glands. Eruptions, with much itching and burning. Erysipelas. Impetigo. Appetite poor. Nausea. Heaviness and pressure after eating. Distended and tender. Flatulence. Chronic diarrhoea. Compare: Anacardium orientale; Rhus toxicodendron; Cantharis. Third to sixth potency.
